text: MORNING: the star keeper wakes. the meadow is open.
A BELL JINGLES: QUEEN BUNBUN hops to meet you.
KING MOCHI wobbles up. the cuties bow.
the lantern twinkles. the meadow remembers every friend.
coins and candy lie in the grass. finders keepers.
pudding imps nibble the signposts. the meadow giggles.
candy cultists sing from the trees. they made you a song.
a sign reads: DO NOT FEED THE MARSHMALLOW OGRES.
SNACK TIME: the burrows open. brace yourself.
lollipop guards stand at the gate. what are they guarding?
SNACK TIME: more tumble out of the ball pit.
the queen is quiet. her ears turn to follow you.
SNACK TIME: hamsters pour from the wheel in a spiral.
your paws are steady. you are braver than when you came.
NAP TIME: every cutie comes at once.
the jingles stop. something very big and very soft is coming.
